text:
jen: Quick notenoticed invoice-preview for a small EU cohort showing ~2% extra tokens in 'unattributed' after route-resolver v2 roll. customers not billed, but CS noise.

david: timeline? which change rolled?

jen: rolled at 03:12 UTC. v2 moved resolver around enrich; preview consumer still reads pre-enrichment topic for now. finalizer reads enriched topic so final invoices look fine.

maya: can we show a confidence indicator in the console? even a simple low/med/high would help CS triage.

alan: short-term: flip preview consumer to consume enriched topic in EU as a canary (single partition). long-term: either move enrichment upstream or unify the preview/final pipelines.

clare: if we flip the preview source, will it affect quota accounting telemetry used by billing SRE?

jen: flip is read-only; it shouldn't change final ledger. preview is only for UI. but it will change what preview reports (good).

metering-bot: found 41 preview events with null route_resolution in window 7901234400..7901234500 (eu).

engops-bot: proposed alert: preview_vs_final_delta.{region} > 1% for 5m -> #eng-platform, pager if >5% for 10m.

david: agree. I'll add a preview_confidence boolean to the preview payload plus a small banner on the preview card: 'Preview may be incomplete during routing rollouts.' tooltip links to runbook.

maya: support blurb: "Preview is for guidance only; final invoices are authoritative. If you see unexpected attribution, please wait 5 minutes or include the preview id when contacting support."

alan: also propose adding a dashboard card that shows ‘preview_confidence’ distribution across tenants and an alert when a region's median confidence < 0.9.

clare: good. can the alert exclude canary windows (deployments)? we don't want noise during a rollout.

jen: engops-bot can mark deployment windows via tag; we'll make alert ignore tagged rollout intervals for 15m after tag.

metering-bot: created ticket BILL-2981 "preview attribution mismatch during route-resolver roll" assigned to jen/alan/david.

jen: starting canary: preview-consumer->read-enriched (eu, partition-5). will report back.

engops-bot: deploy started. CI green.

jen: canary metrics: preview_vs_final delta dropped from 2.1% -> 0.15% within 6m. promoting region after 30m stable.

david: I'll ship the UI flag behind a feature toggle so we can revert quickly if anything unexpected.

maya: I'll post the CS note and include the reconcile query: SELECT session_id, SUM(tokens) FROM preview WHERE ts>t0 GROUP BY session_id JOIN final USING(session_id) HAVING preview_sum != final_sum;

alan: follow-up: schedule design session to decide enrichment placement and whether preview should always read the enriched stream.

jen: closing: no customer billing impact. follow-ups in BILL-2981. thanks all. :thumbsup:
